source.name: OpenRouter models API
source.selection_note: Dated catalog top-provider/default-condition snapshot. These are reference tariffs, not guaranteed lowest-provider quotes or an actual bill.
source.retention_note: The digest was calculated from the full retrieved catalog response bytes. This snapshot retains only allowlisted reference fields, not the complete catalog response.

exact_model_note: The checked OpenRouter catalog did not list Qwen3.5-4B. The other Qwen models below supply illustrative tariffs only; they were not measured in this paired pilot.
catalog_website_mismatch_note: At the same check, the public Qwen3.5-9B model page displayed $0.08/$0.13 per million input/output tokens, while the Models API returned $0.17/$0.25. The Models API documentation identifies catalog pricing as top-provider/default-condition pricing. This snapshot consistently uses the dated API values, not the model-page quote.
assumptions: Reprice the observed local qwen3.5:4b token counts at illustrative hosted tariffs; these projections are neither observed hosted usage nor an invoice.
Charge every reported input token at the uncached standard prompt rate.
Charge every reported generated token, including thinking, once at the completion rate.
Do not assume hosted tokenizer or image-tokenization equivalence; actual hosted token counts may differ.
Do not model cache discounts, request or image surcharges, conditional context rates, routing changes, credit-purchase fees or taxes.
These tariffs do not estimate local electricity, hardware or total local cost. The saved local pilot reports a zero provider inference fee.
